environment.description: Kubernetes 1.24 cluster running the CI/CD pipeline plugin as a Deployment in the 'ci-system' namespace. The plugin's ServiceAccount has cluster-admin equivalent RBAC for managing build workloads. No PodSecurityPolicy or Pod Security Standards are configured. The cluster uses default permissive admission. The JWT public key is mounted from a ConfigMap at /etc/pipeline/keys/public.pem and is readable by the application.
